goal: Add a configuration loading module to the existing SampleApp project that supports JSON file loading with proper error handling.

nodes.title: Inspect project structure
nodes.specification: Explore the SampleApp project directory to understand the existing structure, identify relevant modules, and locate existing tests.

nodes.title: Review existing tests
nodes.specification: Run existing tests to establish a baseline and understand the test framework being used.

nodes.title: Design config loader module
nodes.specification: Design a configuration loading module that supports JSON file loading with proper error handling, including validation and sensible defaults.

nodes.title: Implement config loader
nodes.specification: Create the config_loader.py module with functions to load JSON config files, handle missing files, invalid JSON, and missing required fields with appropriate error messages.

nodes.title: Write unit tests for config loader
nodes.specification: Create comprehensive unit tests for the config loader module covering: successful loading, file not found, invalid JSON, missing required fields, and default values.

nodes.title: Run all tests to verify no regressions
nodes.specification: Run the complete test suite to ensure all existing tests still pass and new config loader tests pass.
